questions.question: What does Zephaniah 2 call the people to do before the day of the LORD?
options: Take up their arms and fight against the coming foe
Build up very high walls all around the whole city
Flee away to Egypt and find what safety they can there
Gather together and seek the LORD and humility
questions.answer: Gather together and seek the LORD and humility

questions.question: Which nations does Zephaniah 2 pronounce judgment against?
options: Egypt, Babylon, Persia, Greece, and old Media
Philistia, Moab, Ammon, Cush, and Assyria
questions.answer: Philistia, Moab, Ammon, Cush, and Assyria

questions.question: Zephaniah 2 declares that Nineveh, the exultant city, will become a desolation.
Seek the LORD, all you humble of the land; seek righteousness, seek _____.
This is the exultant city that lived securely, that said in her heart, 'I am, and there is no one _____ me.'
